title: Lesson 9 - OmniStudio License Requirements and Permission Set Licenses
description: Explain Omnistudio license requirements, Permission Set Licenses and Permission Sets.

questions.question: A user has been assigned an OmniStudio Permission Set but still cannot use the OmniStudio features. What is the most likely missing piece?
options: The user needs a Permission Set License, which grants the right to use the licensed feature, in addition to the Permission Set.
The user needs a new laptop.
The user needs to be an admin.
The user needs to restart the browser.
questions.explanation: The Permission Set License grants the right to use the licensed feature, while the Permission Set grants the actual access, and both are typically required, so a user with only the Permission Set is missing the license. Option B is wrong because hardware is not the issue. Option C is wrong because admin rights are not the missing license. Option D is wrong because a browser restart does not grant a license.

questions.question: An architect is planning which users get OmniStudio access. What is the correct approach to licensing?
options: Assign the Permission Set License and Permission Set only to the users who actually need OmniStudio features.
Assign every user in the org both the license and the permission set.
Assign no licenses and rely on the base platform.
Assign only the Permission Set License to everyone.
questions.explanation: The architect should assign the Permission Set License and Permission Set only to users who actually need OmniStudio features, because over-licensing costs money and under-licensing blocks users. Option B is wrong because licensing everyone wastes money. Option C is wrong because OmniStudio is a licensed product that needs the license. Option D is wrong because the Permission Set is also required for actual access.

questions.question: What is the difference between a Permission Set License and a Permission Set in OmniStudio?
options: They are the same thing with two names.
The Permission Set License determines whether a user is entitled to the feature, while the Permission Set determines what the user can actually do with it.
The Permission Set grants the license automatically.
The Permission Set License is only for admins.
questions.explanation: The Permission Set License determines whether a user is entitled to the licensed feature, while the Permission Set determines what the user can actually do with it, and both are typically required. Option A is wrong because they are distinct layers. Option C is wrong because a Permission Set does not grant the license. Option D is wrong because the Permission Set License is not admin-only.
